name: Tigernmas
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: a founder of the gold craft
name forms Tigernmas, Tighernmas, and Tiernmas
a legendary high king of early Ireland
credited with the introduction of gold-smelting
set up the worship of Crom Cruach

text: Tigernmas is a legendary high king of early Ireland. His name also appears as Tighernmas and Tiernmas. MacKillop credits him with two great firsts. He introduced the smelting of gold to Ireland, founding one of its oldest crafts. He also set up the worship of Crom Cruach, the grim idol god. Monaghan remembers that cult as cruel. The worship of the idol was the dark mark of his reign. The king thus stands at the head of both the gold craft and the darkest cult of the old tales. Few Irish kings carry so sharp a double name.

okr.objective: Set Tigernmas over the gold craft and the Crom Cruach cult.
key_results: Keep the Crom Cruach worship as the dark mark of his reign
